public.prompt: Within one route, `RouteContext` serves a `ThemePreview` that reads only `theme` and a `PointerReadout` that reads only coordinates updated on every move. Profiling shows the preview rerendering for coordinate changes. Context must remain the distribution mechanism. Which local refactor isolates the hot updates?

options.label: Memoize one combined `{ theme, pointer }` value with both fields in the provider's dependencies.
Provide `theme` and `pointer` through separate route contexts and subscribe each consumer to its field.
Wrap `ThemePreview` in `memo` while keeping its subscription to the combined route context.

answerProof.summary: Two route-local contexts align provider propagation with the two subscription needs, so coordinate changes do not publish a new value to the theme-only consumer.
decisiveConstraints: The route has one theme-only consumer and one coordinate-only consumer.
The coordinate provider changes at pointer frequency while the theme provider rarely changes.
Context remains the required distribution mechanism.

claims.statement: React rerenders consumers when their context provider receives a different value, and memoization of the consumer does not block fresh context values.

optionRationales.explanation: The combined object still changes identity whenever coordinates change, so both consumers subscribed to that provider receive the update.
optionRationales.plausibility: Memoizing a provider object avoids updates caused only by an unrelated parent render.
optionRationales.falsifyingConstraint: One declared dependency changes on every pointer movement.

optionRationales.explanation: Each route provider now changes at its own cadence, and each consumer subscribes only to the update domain it reads.
A component that reads a changed context value rerenders even when `memo` can otherwise skip parent-driven renders with equal props.
optionRationales.plausibility: Memo can skip a child render when only its parent rerenders and its props remain equal.
optionRationales.falsifyingConstraint: These components directly subscribe to the changing combined context.
